__note: docs/35 Phase 4 — Chakra UI (@chakra-ui/react@3.37.0) as a reader subject (runtime Emotion). Mount recipe from Chakra's own docs: ChakraProvider value={defaultSystem}. Flat exports CheckboxRoot / Textarea (the package also ships Checkbox.Root namespace form; flat names avoid a sandbox barrel). classAllow keeps chakra-* identity classes and drops Emotion css-<hash> classes so part identity does not thrash across builds. varPrefix --chakra- matches the :root custom properties defaultSystem injects. No hand-authored recipe fixture table — capture + reader proposal only.

mount.__note: ChakraProvider is REQUIRED — without it, defaultSystem tokens never land on :root and Emotion recipes resolve against nothing. value={defaultSystem} is the library's documented default theme. Probe-witnessed 2026-08-31: CheckboxRoot + Textarea mount and paint real computed styles (control 20×20, checked fill rgb(24,24,27)).
